description: Traffic Signal Vehicle and Pedestrian Volumes is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset contains the most recent 8 peak hour vehicle and pedestrian volume counts collected at intersections where there are traffic signals. The data is typically collected between the hours of 7:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are car count, car volume, pedestrian volume, traffic count, traffic movement. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2023-09-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
